partners.bio: CA. Kunal Darwani is a Fellow Member of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India and holds the Post Qualification Course certificate in Information Systems Audit (DISA) from ICAI. His practice covers income tax, GST, company law compliance and business structuring for proprietors, firms, LLPs and companies. He works with clients on compliance calendars, departmental notices and the tax implications of business decisions, and writes regularly on regulatory updates for the firm's knowledge section.

partners.name: CA. Reet Darwani
areas: Foreign accounting outsourcing (US, UK, UAE, Australia)
partners.bio: CA. Reet Darwani is a Fellow Member of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India and holds a Master of Commerce degree. She leads the firm's accounting, financial reporting and audit engagements, including outsourced accounting for overseas businesses and accounting firms. Her work focuses on clean books, documented processes and timely month-end closes that make audits and tax filings straightforward.
